title: Horizon
description: An OutRun-style horizon in place of the backdrop's cross street: the road bends away past its far edge to a vanishing point under a low skyline, for Woof Way and Paws Promenade, each beside the current run screen. The camera is unchanged.

title: Roadside
description: Woof Way's lawns beyond the sidewalks with OutRun-style roadside billboards (houses behind picket fences and hedges, mailboxes, trees, lamp posts, a gnome, a bike, a washing line) that scale with depth and scroll with the road, beside today's bare verge, with the 18 new sprites and their sizes.

title: Sprite scale
description: Woof Way at today's scale beside 40px dogs, a 40x60 walker and 64px lanes on the same 360x560 screen, and the bigger scale with 3.5 s of road in view instead of 5.25 s, with the camera numbers for each.

title: Start screen shop
description: The start screen with help, sound and settings top right, a one-item Pocket in place of the Gear section, and a pet shop for gear, dogs and slots: a shop building in the gate scene or a SHOP button, the shop page, and the locked tile states.
